name: Return to Virgin Bay
source:
"Return to Virgin Bay" is a dating sim set in a seaside town populated by beautiful women of every desire. And you are a young journalist who has just returned here. Working for a sultry boss, you will discover the changes that have taken place in this once hospitable town, and meet new, questionable and seductive characters to help you ease back in.​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/virgin_bay]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《重返维尔京湾》是一款约会模拟游戏，故事发生在一个海滨小镇，那里挤满了各色美女。而你是一位刚回国的年轻记者。为一个性感的老板工作，你会发现这个曾经热情好客的小镇所发生的变化，并遇到新的、可疑的和诱人的角色，帮助你轻松地重新融入其中。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/virgin_bay]Patreon[/url]]
